summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its extrajudicial reorganization petition under Brazilian law (Law 11,101/05) with the 2nd Bankruptcy Court in São Paulo. The petition covers approximately US$ 10.9 billion in unsecured financial obligations. Creditors representing 39.6% of the claims signed the plan. The company has 90 days to obtain approval of an updated plan binding all claims. Parameters include maturity extensions, interest capitalization, potential shareholder liquidity support, equity backstop commitments, and possible equitization. Watch for creditor negotiations and plan approval within the statutory period.
